name: Re-run hides results
description: Re-running replaces previous results with 'Running...'; old rows vanish until new ones arrive (loading-refresh).

name: Results offline
description: Network loss mid-run shows raw EHOSTUNREACH text; no offline explanation or retry (UtilityTabResults.tsx:39).

name: Very large result
description: Wide or huge results under 'No limit'; ambiguous how grid copes beyond browser limits.

name: Long-running query, no cancel
description: While running, only a spinner shows; no Stop/Cancel, only a separate 'View running queries' link.

name: Target database unclear
description: Run button never restates target (production primary vs replica, role); context lives in separate selectors.
trigger: Run on primary DB with postgres role (UtilityActions.tsx:258)

name: Results lost on reload
description: Results live in session state only; after refresh the panel resets to 'Click Run'.

name: Multiple statements result
description: Only results[id][0] renders; ambiguous which statement's output a multi-statement run shows.

name: Undetected destructive query
description: Heuristic analyzeQueryIssues may miss destructive SQL (e.g. inside DO blocks); ambiguous coverage.
trigger: Destructive statement the analyzer doesn't parse (useSqlEditorExecution.ts:97)

name: Snippet fetch failed
description: A 500 or network error loading content leaves both panels spinning forever, no message or retry.

name: Snippet from other project
description: Opening another project's snippet silently redirects to a blank new query with no explanation.

name: Manual save failed
description: In manual mode a failed save shows no error; label just says 'Unsaved edits' again.
trigger: upsertContent throws in manual mode (sql-editor-save.ts:103; UtilityActions.tsx:110)

name: No permission to save
description: Users without create permission get one toast on New; the editor itself never says work won't save.

name: Concurrent edits conflict
description: Same snippet edited in two tabs or by two sessions: last write wins silently, no conflict notice.
trigger: Two browser tabs on one snippet (sql-editor-save.ts:91)

name: Empty-list copy wrong in manual mode
description: Empty panel promises queries are 'automatically saved', which is false under manual save.
trigger: Manual save on, no private snippets (PrivateSqlSnippetEmpty.tsx:8)

name: Snippet list fetch failed
description: Error toasts, then list shows 'No private queries created yet' as if the user has none.

name: Search failed
description: SearchList has no error branch; a failed search likely reads as 'No queries found'.

name: Export unsaved snippet
description: CLI command downloads the server copy; unsaved or never-saved edits are silently missing (ambiguous).

name: Delete folder failed
description: Folder delete mutation has no onError here; ambiguous whether a default toast fires or dialog just stops.

name: Many tabs overflow
description: Tab bar with many open snippets; overflow behavior not visible in feature files.

name: AI diff accept fails silently
description: Accept returns early with no message when editor or diff isn't ready (TODO in code).

name: Editor chunk loading
description: Monaco is dynamically imported with no loading fallback; area stays blank on slow networks.

name: Chart with no results
description: Chart tab before any run or with zero rows; ChartConfig not read, behavior unverified.
trigger: Open Chart tab with no result (UtilityPanel.tsx:187)

name: Toast stack
description: Several failures at once (autosave, list, run) stack toasts; ambiguous ordering and limit.

name: First-time
description: New user lands on /sql/new with no snippets; only placeholder and templates guide them.

name: Offline
description: Connection drops: runs, autosave and list fetch fail separately with no unified offline banner.

name: Slow connection
description: Slow network stretches Monaco load, snippet fetch and query run spinners.

name: Session expired
description: Auth expires mid-edit: autosave fails quietly; unsaved SQL must survive re-login.

name: Project paused or unhealthy
description: Database unreachable (paused, restoring, upgrading); runs fail with raw errors.

name: Stale app version
description: Persisted tabs/local state from an older deploy after an update.

name: Keyboard navigation
description: Cmd+Enter run, Cmd+S save, focus leaving Monaco, dialog focus traps.

problems.label: Clickable elements a keyboard can't reach (div or span with a click handler)

name: Screen reader
description: Run status, errors and results announced; Monaco and grid accessible.

name: High contrast
description: Error-line highlight and unsaved dot must not rely on colour alone.

name: Reduced motion
description: Spinners and AI animation respect prefers-reduced-motion.
